services.name: Website Design & Development
services.short: Sites built to convert, not just to launch.

services.short: Make the tools you already pay for talk to each other.
services.body: Information should move on its own. We connect your platforms with source-of-truth rules, error handling and monitoring — an integration backbone, not a brittle export that breaks the first time someone renames a field.

services.body: Project and program management, technical architecture, and delivery oversight — from a practice that builds the work rather than only reporting on it. Available by the project, by the day, or as an ongoing retainer.

work.name: Sovereign Valor Group
work.body: Sixteen pages generated from structured data by a custom Node build pipeline, so every page, the sitemap and the structured data stay in sync from one source. Google Analytics 4 with custom conversion events, JSON-LD for search, a working contact form, and a dedicated accessibility statement. Custom responsive design on a continuous deployment pipeline — this site ships more than most builds in its own $9,500 bracket.

work.name: Family Reunion: Spades & Bones
work.body: A social multiplayer card and dominoes game on Next.js and TypeScript, with a complete Spades rules engine — jokers, nil and blind nil bidding, follow-suit and renege enforcement, full bag and sandbag scoring — plus Partnership All Fives dominoes. Seven AI opponents with distinct written personalities and over 300 rotating lines of table talk. Ten deck themes and ten table backgrounds rendered entirely in CSS, with keyboard navigation and screen-reader support throughout.

work.name: Lottery Pattern Engine
work.body: Pattern analysis across Lotto Texas, Powerball, Mega Millions and Pick 3. Data ingestion, statistical analysis and a web interface, running in active maintenance.

work.name: Devotion After Victory
work.body: A connection platform for the veteran community: native Android and iOS applications alongside the web platform, backed by a managed Postgres service with authentication. A beta access programme with invite codes and member badges, and payment processing integration. 374 commits.

work.name: Accountability Workout App
work.body: A platform connecting trainers and clients through video coaching, daily check-ins, and workout and meal planning. Built as a package-managed monorepo on Next.js with a managed Postgres backend, continuous integration, and full product specifications maintained in-repo. 222 commits.

work.name: Vocasa
work.body: A voice-powered application that turns spoken instructions and rough sketches into editable, to-scale residential floor plans. TypeScript and Next.js.

work.name: Lumira
work.body: A multisensory virtual reality experience built to make reading and mathematics click for dyslexic learners, through movement, sound and play.
